cards.ex: Visiting grandma every Sunday is a time-honored tradition in our family.

cards.ex: Canada is often described as a cultural mosaic, with its diverse population.
cards.exUz: Kanada ko'pincha o'zining xilma-xil aholisi bilan madaniy mozaika sifatida tasvirlanadi.

cards.ex: Strong families contribute to social cohesion within the community.

cards.ex: My grandmother passed down her recipe for apple pie to me.

cards.uzDef: Avloddan avlodga o'tkazish, meros qilib qoldirish.

cards.ex: The government invests in cultural preservation projects.
cards.exUz: Hukumat madaniy merosni saqlash loyihalariga sarmoya kiritadi.
cards.uzDef: Madaniy merosni himoya qilish va saqlash.

cards.exUz: U o'z fikrida qat'iy turishga qaror qildi va murosaga kelishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikriga sodiq qolish, qat'iy pozitsiyani saqlash.

cards.exUz: So'nggi yillarda an'anaviy musiqaning madaniy tiklanishi kuzatilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Eski madaniyatlarni qayta tiklash va jonlantirish.

cards.exUz: An'anaviy xattotlik yo'qolib borayotgan san'atga aylanib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kamdan-kam uchraydigan va yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida bo'lgan san'at turi.

cards.exUz: U doimo oqimga qarshi harakat qiladi, an'anaviy donolikka qarshi chiqadi.

cards.exUz: Ko'p amerikaliklar uchun beysbol oddiyroq zamonlarni ifodalovchi madaniy yodgorlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat uchun juda muhim va qadrlanadigan madaniy narsa yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: Shared traditions act as a social glue, strengthening community bonds.
cards.exUz: Umumiy urf-odatlar ijtimoiy bog'lovchi bo'lib, jamoa aloqalarini mustahkamlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni birga ushlab turadigan narsa, umumiy qadriyatlar yoki ishonchlar.
